lines.t: Holdin' fast I see the dawn in the sky
Preparing my heart for when You arrive
Old shadows fall like leaves in the rain
Trading my sorrow for joy in the pain
Every step I take feels lighter
Every prayer makes the flame brighter
Holdin' fast cuz I know You near
Shedding my chains leaving my fear
Grace flows down like a healin' flood
Renew my soul with Your flesh and blood
Striving forward breaking through the haze
Running this race til the end of my days
Repentin' each tear like a river it flows
Grateful for mercy in every tomorrow
Faith replaces the cracks in my soul
You the refuge that makes me whole
Every breath is a gift not owed
I’m free
I’m free in the love You’ve shown
Holdin' fast cuz I know You near
Sheddin' my chains leaving my fear
Grace flows down like a healin' flood
Renew my soul with Your flesh and blood
